We spent a long time working through that, and I can clearly recall our back-and-forth, the weight of those conversations, and how much energy we put into making sure we were truly understanding them. I remember the effort we took to get through the noise and just reach them. 

I’m sorry I lost sight of that in my recent attempts—I went back to "debugging" mode when I should ha...
